findings.finding: A valid paper can produce zero selected lots and both a stock reason and per-lot authority_unavailable. Example: one matching regiment is committed and the other is free but outside the issuing mandate's regions. arriveAllocation has already passed paper-level authority and records a complying zero-selection deferral. lotDeferredAllocation requires every reason to be a stock reason, so it reports a terminal decline, allows renewed requester choices on changed evidence and will never recognize later eligible receipts/releases. Distinguish the accepted wait from candidate-level exclusion and preserve current authority checks at wake/choice.

The direct-answer path selects its first active assign grant by key before checking scope, usable lots or modes. An unrelated grant can prevent a direct answer even when a second grant covers the sender, recipient, destination and candidate lot. An empty-mode grant ahead of an otherwise identical nonempty grant yields a false typed gap. Filter/evaluate the issuing holder's actual scoped grants, and use deterministic ordering among viable grants without borrowing modes from another grant or subordinate.

A governor's absent, empty or mismatched received stamp becomes modes_unavailable only if there is also a proposed sending. When a formerly promising return is stale and no lot is currently available, proposed is undefined and a complying governor emits no_eligible_force or generic defer without the required modes gap. Preserve the received mode gap independently of inventory and any independently applicable compliance reason. Never dispatch from the invalid stamp.
